title: Protect skin, and a film-skin finish
body: Strong recipes shouldn't turn faces orange. Protect skin fades a recipe's colour on skin tones and keeps it everywhere else, and it deliberately leaves wood and other warm surfaces alone. The same day a film-skin finish went in for every film, and the portrait recipes were retuned for it. Portrait recipes open with no grain, because grain adds texture a face doesn't want.
There are no pictures in this chapter: the test frames are portraits, and this diary shows no faces.
